summary: Flat start of a narrow street under bush, houses 14 m across.
reasons: Bush bank on the kerb side

drivers.seclusion: Bush and a scrub slope behind the kerb; detached houses 14 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street; cars park along the south side, so a van on the north bush side leaves a tight lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential side street that links two roads.
drivers.convention: 2P resident-permit signs weekdays only; a few cars parked on the south side.

flags: Steep after 25 m: 11% mean over whole stretch, 22% max
Homes 14 m away across the road
sun_shade: Eucalypt canopy and scrub on the north side; morning and midday shade likely.

best_section.where: First 20 m from the Carmody Road junction, bush side
